confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cape Town's tourist price levels, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by season, neighbourhood and booking channel. July is low season for much of Cape Town's tourism, so accommodation may run below peak. Beer, coffee, cocktail and wine are estimated from typical local price levels, with the wine and cocktail figures anchored to the beer price, since direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX observation was taken from RBA search-result snippets; I did not open the RBA table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South African coastal tourist cities such as Durban, with Cape Town priced higher than typical South African inland cities because of tourism demand. Restaurant and bar prices are placed between Johannesburg and mid-range Mediterranean tourist cities. Accommodation is placed at the level of mid-sized tourist cities in the region.
